Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this game and it is the hosts, Sri Lanka who have taken a 1-0 lead in the three-match T20I series against Afghanistan who will believe that they can make a comeback as they really got close in this game as well. Sri Lanka on the other hand will have their eyes on sealing the series in the next game. The 2nd T20I will be played at the very same ground in Dambulla on Monday, 19 February and will begin at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). However, you can catch our build-up to the game a lot sooner. Cheers!

Wanindu Hasaranga, the skipper of Sri Lanka says that it was a close game and says he feels they were 15 runs short. Adds that he didn't try to overdo anything and held onto the basics. Says that the batters should take more responsibility in the coming games. Ends up by saying that they will perform more strongly in the second game.

Ibrahim Zadran, the skipper of Afghanistan says that he doesn't like losing but it is part of the game and they gave their best on the field and will come back stronger. Reckons that it was a chasable score and they had a good Powerplay but wickets in the middle and batters not taking responsibility was the main issue. Adds that it is part of the game and no one wants to commit mistakes and credits the Lankan bowlers who bowled well and didn't have many partners to get the win. Ends by saying that he is happy with his knock but not satisfied and would want to win this type of game for his country.
The Presentation ceremony...

Afghanistan will be thinking long and hard about how they let this game slip and with just 14 runs needed off 12 deliveries, they should have really won. They were more than decent with the ball apart from one phase and all the three frontline pacers got at least a couple of wickets each but it was Fazalhaq Farooqi who was the standout with 3 wickets to his name. Qais Ahmad and Noor Ahmad were both expensive and surprisingly, Mohammad Nabi didn't bowl at all but they did well to bundle out Sri Lanka for 160. With the bat, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran started off well and just when the former got going, he went for one too many shots and gave his wicket away. The skipper stood strong and built a partnership first with Gulbadin Naib and then after they lost a few wickets, he stitched another stand with Karim Janat which got them into a position of promise. Ibrahim also brought up a stellar half-century, however, he kept on losing partners and with 3 wickets intact and two overs to go, they lost two wickets in the 19th over and Ibrahim couldn't perform under pressure in the final over.

Matheesha Pathirana is the POTM for his lethal death bowling and exceptional figures of 4/24 in his four overs. He says he is happy to contribute to the team and it feels special. Says that this was his second T20I for Sri Lanka and that he cannot control his happiness. He adds he has a little experience of playing the IPL and he says that he executed the line and length pretty well in the penultimate over.

After being put into bat first, Sri Lanka lost an in-form Pathum Nissanka early and then the top order put on a few runs but no one could really kick on. It was then a staggering knock from the skipper, Wanindu Hasaranga himself that got the Lankans into a very good position but they lost their way in the final five overs or so and could only hobble to 160 runs. With the ball though, they did get a fairly early wicket thanks to Angelo Mathews but then they conceded a stand and were under the pump. Hasaranga, Matheesha Pathirana and Dasun Shanaka all got into the wickets column soon after and got their side back in the game before another stand took the game away. In the last four overs, Pathirana bowled 2 overs and got 3 wickets at the death hardly giving away any runs as well. Binura Fernando who had an expensive outing, repaid the fate put in him by the captain by bowling four dots on the trot in the final over and sealed a famous victory.

The first-ever T20I match in Dambulla and what a cracker of a game we have witnessed here as hosts Sri Lanka have stolen it at the death in front of a jam-packed home crowd. A frantic last couple of overs but what death bowling from Matheesha Pathirana and even Binura Fernando held his nerves brilliantly in the final over leaving Afghanistan still without a win in this tour and the skipper, Ibrahim Zadran will be the most distraught man out there.

FOUR! Not enough! Sri Lanka steal a sensational win by 4 runs at Dambulla. And it is fair to say that Matheesha Pathirana stood between the win and Afghanistan. Binura holds his line outside off from over the wicket and fuller in length, Ibrahim Zadran throws his bat at it and connects well through extra covers for a boundary. But it is too late. Sri Lanka take the series lead by 1-0 by winning this first T20I. What a humdinger of a contest this has been!

Commentary.Commentary: Wide outside off on a short length, Ibrahim Zadran slashes hard but fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.2: Matheesha Pathirana to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Steams in from over the wicket and pitches it short in front of the stumps, Azmatullah Omarzai stays on the back foot and pats it to point for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 8.1: Matheesha Pathirana to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Matheesha Pathirana has now been brought into the attack.

Follows another wrong'un on a short length, Azmatullah Omarzai rocks back and pulls it to mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark. A successful over for Sri Lanka as they saw the back of Gulbadin Naib.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.6: Wanindu Hasaranga to Azmatullah Omarzai, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Azmatullah Omarzai is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED'EM! The skipper shines and now with the bowl as he breaks a brewing partnership! Bowls a wrong'un on off which slides into the batter after pitching and fuller in length, Gulbadin Naib sits on his knee to slap it over the leg side but ends up play all over it and it goes through his defence before breaking into the stumps. Gulbadin Naib departs and Afghanistan are two down now.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.5: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, OUT! b Wanindu Hasaranga.

Commentary.Commentary: Overpitched and on the stumps, Gulbadin Naib flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.4: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drags his length drifting down leg, Naib misses to flick.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.3: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Just short and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran rocks back and punches it off the back foot to covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.2: Wanindu Hasaranga to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Over the wicket on a full toss and in front of the stumps, Gulbadin Naib slogs it towards long on for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 7.1: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slides back in from off on a fuller length, Gulbadin Naib steers it with wrists to deep square leg for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Drifting down leg on a fuller length, Ibrahim Zadran tucks it to long on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Another misfield. Sri Lanka have been quite sloppy tonight. On full and on stumps, Gulbadin Naib flicks it to mid on where the fielder fails to stop. They cross for one towards long on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a dragged length and around off, Ibrahim Zadran punches it to widish long off for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Brings it back in from off on a fuller length, Naib loses his shape and gets squared up getting an inside edge and onto the pads. It rolls to the off side. But again, a poor display in the field as they offer one more overthrow run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Glorious! Starts off with a leg-break outside off on a fuller length, Gulbadin Naib covers his off stump and uppishly swings it hard over covers for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted ball on the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran lunges ahead and blocks it out to end the over. Just 5 from it. End of the Powerplay and Afghanistan are 57/1.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Wanindu Hasaranga to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Length delivery around off, Ibrahim Zadran punches it off the back foot to covers.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Wanindu Hasaranga to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: In the air...but safe! On off and on a length, Gulbadin Naib mistimes the pull shot which lands somewhere between mid-wicket and mid on. One taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off on a fuller length, Gulbadin Naib tries to sweep again but misses as the ball keeps straight.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Swept away! Full and looped up on the stumps, Naib sits on his knee and sweeps it uppishly towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: The skipper starts off with a tossed-up leg-spinner on a fuller length sliding down leg, Gulbadin Naib looks to go big at it but meets only thin air and the ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Wanindu Hasaranga to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Wanindu Hasaranga brings himself into the attack now.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over and 16 runs come off it. This is bowled full and on middle and leg, Ibrahim Zadran gets the front leg out of the way and clips it a bit aerially in front of square leg for yet another boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Hard length around off, punched away in front of cover for another quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Binura Fernando to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, dear! Sri Lanka are gifting runs away to Afghanistan now. Shorter and at the body, dabbed down to mid-wicket for a quick run. Wanindu Hasaranga picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but the throw is more into the surface. Dasun Shanaka who is backing up gets a bad bounce and the ball eludes him to roll into the boundary. The bowler won't be one bit pleased with that.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, 5 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! This is excellent batting from the Afghanistan skipper. Slightly short and over off and middle, Ibrahim Zadran yet again makes a bit of room and hammers it on the up through covers for a blazing boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Hard length over middle and jagging back in sharply, Gulbadin Naib gets caught on the back foot and gets hit on the pads as the ball rolls away on the off side. The batter pick up a run as there was a bit of an inside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Binura Fernando to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slower and shorter, following the batter down leg, Ibrahim Zadran gets a bit cramped and manages to push it wide of mid on for a quick single yet again.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Doesn't carry! Seemed like the carrom ball and Gulbadin Naib gets all squared up and gets an outside edge that falls in front of Dhananjaya de Silva at backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated up around the off stump, Ibrahim Zadran pushes it out to covers and scampers through for a quick run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Hammered away! Flatter one on middle stump, Ibrahim Zadran backs away well and cuts it hard in front of square on the off side to pick up yet another boundary and Afghanistan are off to a quick start.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR BYES! Through everyone! The inswinger from Maheesh Theekshana, bowled on a length and angled back in sharply. Ibrahim Zadran goes past the leg stump to open up the off side but is beaten and the keeper is beaten too. The ball rolls away into the fine leg fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, 4 Byes.

Commentary.Commentary: Should have been put away! A juicy full toss on the leg peg, Gulbadin Naib decides to just flick it away in front of square leg and picks up a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Gulbadin Naib, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts with a quicker and flatter delivery, shaping it into the body, Ibrahim Zadran backs away and heaves it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for spin early on as Maheesh Theekshana replaces Binura Fernando from the other end.
A bit fuller and on off stump, Gulbadin Naib blocks it off from inside the crease.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Angelo Mathews to Gulbadin Naib, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Gulbadin Naib is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Angelo Mathews has the last laugh here and picks up a big wicket. Floated up on a length and on the stumps, shaping away a bit. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gives charge and looks to heave it across the line but gets a top edge over short third man. Matheesha Pathirana settles under the swirling ball and grabs a brilliant catch. The keeper was also running to it but left it alone and it was the right call in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Matheesha Pathirana b Angelo Mathews
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, OUT! c Matheesha Pathirana b Angelo Mathews.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! That is a poor delivery and Rahmanullah Gurbaz has duly punished it as well. Short and just angling down leg, Gurbaz gets enough on it to beat short fine leg and the ball races away into the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Picked up and dispatched! Pitched up on the stumps and in the hitting arc, Rahmanullah Gurbaz holds his shape and flicks it high and handsome over deep square leg for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, that could have been much worse! Short ball over middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz nails the pull shot toward deep mid-wicket and the ball bursts through the hands of Pathum Nissanka there. Nissanka though recovers well and manages to save the boundary and the batters pick up a couple of runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran tries to fetch and pull but gets it off the toe end toward mid on. The batters scamper through for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Angelo Mathews to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length on the pads, tickled down to fine leg for an easy single to end the over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Slower one from Binura Fernando, a bit fuller and around off, Ibrahim Zadran just pushes it away to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Superb timing! Good length on the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran backs away well and slaps the ball away through the cover region for a second boundary in the over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled! Binura Fernando sees Ibrahim Zadran making room again and follows him with a shortish ball, Zadran gets cramped for room and has to block it off.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Makes room and gets enough on it. Short of a length and over the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran stays leg side and forces it over wide mid on for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, angling across the right-hander, Ibrahim Zadran gets an outside edge on the bounce to the fielder at short third man.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Binura Fernando to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Banged in a bit shorter and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran stays on the back foot and pats it away through cover-point for a single to end the over. Just 3 singles off the first over of the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Angelo Mathews to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: The ball is getting a bit of movement. It will be interesting to see how the Afghanistan batters negotiate the Powerplay.
Excellent running! Pitched up on off stump, Rahmanullah Gurbaz makes a bit of room and taps it straight to mid off for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Nice and full in the channel outside off, gently swinging away from the right-hander. Rahmanullah Gurbaz just watches it go through to the keeper.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Angelo Mathews to Rahmanullah Gurbaz, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Ibrahim Zadran and Afghanistan are underway! Short and outside off, tapped away off the back foot and squarer through covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Angelo Mathews to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: More than half an appeal for LBW but it is turned down and it did seem just a bit too high. Short of a length and over the middle, definitely not short enough to pull. Ibrahim Zadran looks to play a cross-batted shot and misses and wears it on the thigh pad.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Angelo Mathews to Ibrahim Zadran, No run.
